div.span:
•
Also connects to the same API Gateway WebSocket (different client type)

•
Subscribes to specific event channels (e.g. incident, assetUpdate, alert)

•
onEvent(callback) → triggered by backend broadcast (e.g. from an asset)

•
sendCommandToAsset(assetId, command) → backend relays through WebSocket to target asset
